# MalikClaw v2.0.0 — Agentic Era 2026

> Pure-Go autonomous AI agent runtime (<10MB RAM, <1s cold boot) built for both developers and everyday users on any laptop, $10 SBC, or spare Android phone — in English and Urdu (native RTL).

## Overview
MalikClaw is an ultra-lightweight, open-source (MIT) AI agent engine written in Go 1.25+ with a Next.js web interface. It replaces bloated Python/Node.js agent gateways (>1.2GB RAM) with a single standalone binary (~12MB on disk, 8.4MB idle RSS RAM) capable of running 24/7 on Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, LicheePi Nano RISC-V boards, Termux Android phones, laptops, and cloud servers.

## Core v2.0.0 Capabilities
- **Everyday Life Made Easy**: Automate WhatsApp & Telegram replies, morning briefings, Android ADB phone actions, and daily reminders in English or Urdu (`malikclaw onboard`).
- **Defense-in-Depth Zero-Trust Security**:
  - Built-in **SSRF Network Boundary Firewall** (`ValidateURL` / `IsBlockedIP`) blocking private/link-local egress.
  - **Prompt-Injection Structural Guard** (`WrapUntrusted` / `ScanPromptInjection`) isolating untrusted tool outputs.
  - **ed25519 Cryptographic Action Signing** and Human-in-the-Loop approval gates.
- **Smart Multi-Model Cost Router**: Routes simple everyday tasks to fast local Ollama / mini models (`TierFast`) and escalates complex reasoning/coding to frontier models (`TierBalanced` / `TierReasoning`) with automatic 429/5xx fallback.
- **Universal SKILL.md + MCP Ecosystem**: First-class Model Context Protocol (MCP) client and drop-in `SKILL.md` skills (`~/.agents/skills/`, GitHub/ClawHub registries).

## Quick Install
- **Linux / Android (Termux)**: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AbdullahMalik17/malikclaw/main/install.sh | bash`
- **Windows (PowerShell)**: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AbdullahMalik17/malikclaw/main/install.ps1 | iex`
- **macOS**: download `malikclaw_Darwin_arm64.tar.gz` (or `malikclaw_Darwin_x86_64.tar.gz`) from GitHub Releases
- **Linux packages**: `malikclaw_x86_64.deb` / `malikclaw_aarch64.deb` / `malikclaw_x86_64.rpm` from GitHub Releases
- **Docker**: `docker run -d --name malikclaw -p 18790:18790 -v ~/.malikclaw:/root/.malikclaw ghcr.io/abdullahmalik17/malikclaw:latest` (tag `latest` or the release tag, e.g. `v2.0.0`; the Launcher image variant is tagged `launcher`)
- **Go Install**: `go install github.com/AbdullahMalik17/malikclaw/cmd/malikclaw@latest`
